title: 5 Signs Your Blood Sugar Is Too Low at Night
description: Nocturnal hypoglycemia affects 1 in 4 adults over 65 on insulin—discover the subtle signs you might miss and what to do tonight.
primaryKeyword: signs blood sugar too low at night
perplexityQuestions: What is my target A1C level at age 40 with type 2 diabetes?

competitorCoverage: Top-ranking Google articles on diabetes for adults cover basics like types (type 1 vs type 2), symptoms, causes, risk factors (age over 45, family history, obesity), diagnosis via A1C or glucose tests, and treatments including lifestyle changes, oral meds, and insulin.[3][4][6] They emphasize complication prevention (heart disease, neuropathy, retinopathy) and blood sugar targets (70-130 mg/dL fasting).[3] To compete, a new article must include personalized targets by age, doctor questions on monitoring/insulin, and prevention strategies beyond existing senior-focused topics.[1][2]
